findings.explanation: Both INV-1005 and REC-1005 reference PO-1005, but no purchase order document exists anywhere in the transaction evidence, so the spend cannot be validated against an authorized PO.
The receipt REC-1005 is dated 2026-07-18, three days before the invoice INV-1005 dated 2026-07-21, an illogical sequence suggesting misdating or an out-of-order event trail.
